content:
Maria: Kickoff — short 5-day push to finalize LangChain & LlamaIndex adapter interoperability + a Helm-packaged Gateway for marketplace. Deliverables: adapter conformance CI gate, py/ts SDK examples, Helm chart with demo-mode, small sample app for listing, and joint announcement assets.

Josh: I'll own conformance CI and lint rules. Plan to add CircleCI job `adapter-conformance/gate` and flake8/eslint presets. Will also add a lightweight perf reporter.

Ankur: On infra... building a reproducible runner image and injecting vault-based `LC_STAGING_TOKEN`. Proposing test matrix: py3.9|py3.10 x fp16|int8. Also can add a `--usage-cap=1200` flag to the harness.

Tara: I'll run partner comms + announcement calendar. Need an eng blurb and one GIF/sample screenshot by Thursday COB.

LangChain Partner: We'll prepare a tiny demo repo showing Adapter API usage with Redwood Gateway and include a mock runtime toggle. ETA repo link by Wed morning.

Samir: QA here. I'll craft an e2e prompt set (6 prompts) and wire nightly smoke runs against dedicated staging. Requesting a test token scoped to staging.

Lucy: Docs + quickstart: creating `docs/integrations/langchain-llamaindex` skeleton with compatibility matrix (models, seq-len, quant), and migration notes for SDK changes (py->ts examples).

devops-bot: CircleCI job `adapter-conformance/gate` created -> workflow `isv-integration-sprint`. First run queued.

Josh: Noted a subtle runtime mismatch: KV cache semantics differ between adapters. Proposing a 'mock-kv' runtime mode in the harness that implements basic put/get TTL semantics so partners can dev/test locally.

LangChain Partner: We'll adopt the mock-kv approach in the sample app so local dev mirrors CI. Also will add a small README section about cache semantics.

Maria: Action recap:
- Josh: CI job + lint presets + perf reporter (due Tue)
- Ankur: runner image + vault secret + test matrix (due Tue)
- Samir: e2e prompts + nightly job (due Wed)
- Lucy: docs skeleton + migration notes (due Thu)
- Tara: announcement draft + GIF (due Fri)
- LangChain Partner: sample app + mock-kv (due Wed)

Tara: I'll loop in marketing and sales for early access messaging and marketplace listing requirements.

Samir: Quick question — do we want a minimum perf signal to appear in marketplace metadata? e.g., p50 < 250ms for short prompts?

Maria: For now collect perf metrics and surface them as metadata. We'll discuss gating/tiering in the Friday sync.

Josh: I'll emit p50/p95 and tokens/sec per-run as JSON so listing tooling can ingest it automatically.

Ankur: Small infra note: add `demoMode: true/false` in Helm `values.yaml` — demo mounts mock runtime and sets lower resource defaults to make onboarding cheap.

Lucy: I'll include a sample `values.yaml` snippet in the docs and a `preflight.sh` that runs a short healthcheck and a prompt smoke test.

LangChain Partner: We'll provide example connector configs for S3/GCS and a short security note on handling PII in retrieval connectors.

Maria: Final check — 30 min sync Fri 9:30am PT. If blockers arise, post here. Thanks team! :rocket:
